detailed_description: The Invisible Character Generator lets you choose from the invisible characters bundled in the page, set a repeat count from 1 to 100, and copy the generated character sequence. It also shows a grid of available characters so you can copy one character at a time. A simple detector textarea counts occurrences of those same bundled characters in pasted text. It does not provide source-text insertion at the caret, bulk sequences with separators, Unicode normalization controls, codepoint range input, JSON or CSV export, or a full Unicode forensic scanner.
usage_steps: Choose an invisible character from the select menu.
Set the repeat count between 1 and 100.
Copy the generated sequence from the preview area.
Optionally click an individual character card to copy that single character.
Paste text into the detector textarea to count supported invisible characters found in that text.
usage_examples: Copy a zero-width space for a small formatting test.
Generate several repeated invisible characters for a browser UI experiment.
Paste text into the detector to see whether supported zero-width characters are present.
Copy one bundled invisible character from the character grid.
